result: The original omission reproduced in both control calls and both treatment calls. No observed improvement.
interpretation: This field-description reminder was insufficient for the original mixed paragraph. Outputs are consistent with losing the scope relationship when an illustrative example becomes a separate rule. They do not establish the internal cause.
next_proposed_test: Explicitly instruct that illustrative examples inherit the governing conditions of the rule they illustrate, unless the source changes scope. Compare against the existing control on this paragraph and an example with an explicit scope change, before considering any production change.
